decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block FAQ attribute and rewrites all affected ticket, pool, delivery, allocation, and fiat-buyer copy for Small Block only.
A same-message MODIFY already records the $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block prize pool; the other Small Block mechanics remain valid unchanged.
A same-message MODIFY already narrows no-referral ticket allocation from both draws to Small Block only.
A same-message MODIFY already replaces the About-page process copy with Small Block-only tickets and never-ending $500 prizes, removing the obsolete Big Block references.
A same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket issuance and lifecycle attributes while preserving the Small Block issuance rules.
A same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket counter, leaving only the valid Small Block counter.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the requirement to announce remaining prize winners on the Winners page and notify them through dashboard and email.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the $15 price, $5 founder share, $5 commission share, and $5 allocation exclusively to the Small Block prize pool.
The removal of Big Block prizes does not alter the established automatic direct-wallet delivery mode for the remaining Small Block prizes.
A same-message MODIFY already rewrites the mission-page prize-pool section to describe only the remaining Small Block pool and its never-ending $500 prizes.
A same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata attribute.
The source preserves a $5 affiliate allocation and does not change the existing rule that assigns the $5 commission to a random NFT holder when no referral code is used.
